thread:
maria: Quick copy pass on the Deploys table 'Help' tooltip — current copy says "Click for docs" but that opens a small modal, not an external doc. Users are expecting a full docs page and it causes misclicks. Suggestion: 'Open quick help' or 'Quick help (modal)'. Also the link looks too primary; maybe desaturate the blue.

ev an: Agreed. Short + clear wins. I prefer `Open quick help` because it uses an action verb. For accessibility we should also set an `aria-label` like: `Open quick help dialog`.

jamal: Accessibility nit: contrast on the tooltip trigger is borderline. Current token #5A9BF5 on white gives ~3.6:1 at 14px. We need >=4.5:1 for button-like affordances. Two options: desaturate to ~#2F6BB0 or add a 1px outline (prefer color change).

maria: Good catch. Also UX-wise the underline makes it read like a link. If it's opening a dialog, maybe switch to an info icon `i` with a tooltip to avoid the expectation of navigation.

ev an: Thinking out loud — icon + text tooltip could work. Tooltip copy proposal: `Open quick help` (primary) and the tooltip body: `Short tips and links — opens a dialog`. Keep the label short. Example aria + QA attrs:

```
aria-label="Open quick help dialog"
data-qa="deploys-help-tooltip"
```

jamal: Ran the contrast check after testing #2F6BB0 — passes at 4.8:1. I'll open a tiny token PR and add a fallback border for older themes.

design-bot: Checklist: copy updated? NO. contrast PR? PENDING. update PR with aria-label? NO. @maria please file the small copy PR. :robot_face:

maria: Will do. Also while we're touching copy — the empty state in Rollouts currently says "No rollouts" which is too terse. Suggest: "No active rollouts yet. Create a rollout to start serving traffic." More action-oriented and tells them the next step.

ev an: Love that. Tweak to keep it single-sentence: "No active rollouts yet. Create a rollout to start serving traffic."

jamal: Quick note — if we add a CTA in that empty state, ensure the CTA has an explicit focus style (1px ring) and an accessible label.

maria: Noted. I'll include the updated tooltip copy, aria-label, and empty-state copy in one small PR. Ping me if you want to review before merge. :thumbsup:

ev an: I'll skim and approve if the aria and contrast bits are in. Thanks!

maria: Filing PR now. Thread closed unless someone has more microcopy nits.
